cccma_ppp.preprocessing.utils_preprocessing.align_stat_data_lead_time_inverse_transform(ds: DataArray | Dataset, stat: DataArray | Dataset, lead_time_resolution: Literal['day', 'month'] = 'month', init_time_dim: str = 'time', lead_time_dim: str = 'lead_time') → DataArray | Dataset

Align preprocessing statistics with data for inverse transformation.

Statistics containing a lead-time dimension are aligned using initialization times. Otherwise, forecast valid times are used.

Temporal grouping dimensions (‘year’, ‘month’, ‘day’) are aligned to the appropriate temporal coordinates.

Parameters:

  • ds (xr.DataArray | xr.Dataset) – Data to be inverse-transformed.

  • stat (xr.DataArray | xr.Dataset) – Fitted preprocessing statistics.

  • lead_time_resolution (lead_time_unit) – Resolution of forecast lead times.

  • init_time_dim (str) – Initialization-time dimension name.

  • lead_time_dim (str) – Lead-time dimension name.

Returns:

Temporally aligned statistics.

Return type:

xr.DataArray | xr.Dataset
